evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.979 Torr at approximately 750 °C and 100 sccm Ar before growth.
Growth pressure rose to 3.110 Torr, then continued rising at each observation.
Pressure reached 3.298 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints, approximately 10% above the preceding baseline.
Temperature 750.2 °C and Ar 100.3 sccm track setpoints; heater power is steady at 44.9%.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; oxygen ingress cannot be assessed from telemetry.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure profile and independent pressure verification; leak-integrity and exhaust-conductance checks to distinguish ingress from exhaust restriction or other pressure causes. Sample characterization is not yet available.
